newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor okays talks with Siemens unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor okays talks with Siemens unit.

text.p: The state-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) board has approved a negotiated deal with a unit of Siemens AG for the sale of its unused uranium, Napocor president Guido Delgado told reporters on Tuesday.
He said the decision of the board will still be subject to the approval of the Cabinet-level Committee on Privatisation (COP).

Siemens Power Corp was one of two companies which participated in the bidding held last month to dispose of its unused nuclear fuel. Both bids were below the indicative price of $32.64 million set by the COP.
The uranium was supposed to be used by Napocor for a 620-megawatt nuclear power plant that was built in the 1980s but was never put into operation because of a legal battle with its builders.
Delgado said the management favoured a negotiated deal because Siemens' bid was reasonably attractive. Moreover, the price of uranium is on a downward trend.
The bidding last month was the second failed attempt to sell the uranium.
